verses.1: This is your ruin, O daughter of Jerusalem, which was written by the prophet, that as the deeds and abominations of the people of Sodom and Gomorrah were, so also are your deeds and your abominations, O daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.2: And as with Sodom and Gomorrah, so your ruin has planted the vine of Sodom in fornication and in pride.
verses.3: And there is no rain of mercy and compassion upon them, but a rain of pride and fornication, which makes the vine of Sodom grow without toil, and without labor and weariness; and they have forgotten the name of God their Lord.
verses.4: And they do not know their Creator apart from their idols, and their deeds are evil, and they delight in the work of their hands, and they commit adultery with male and female.
verses.5: And they do not know the Lord by their deeds, for their eyes are blind so that they do not see, and their ears are deaf so that they do not hear, and they do not do the will of the Lord. And that which makes the vine of Sodom grow, its fruit is bitter, and the fruit of Gomorrah, which does not ripen to sweetness.
verses.6: And when the vine of Sodom is pruned, it becomes a poison that kills, for from its creation it was planted in bitterness, and its fruit came in the time of harvest.
verses.7: And at all times there is no good in the fruit of the vine of Sodom, for in the shadow of Sheol the vine of Sodom was planted, and with a hot wind their fruit withered.
verses.8: And when it bore fruit and was gathered, it became for drunkenness and for punishment, and for those who drink it, it hardens their hearts and makes them forget the covenant, being far from God.
verses.9: And it is a dwelling place for the devil, for in its evil work they walk; and the fruit of Sodom is taken in a snare and ascends into the mountains and into the heights.
verses.10: And it is offered to Baal, whom the nations worship, and they sacrifice sons and daughters to demons, who do not distinguish between evil and good.
verses.11: And they shed innocent blood, and in the winepresses they press out the juice of the vine of Sodom.
verses.12: And again, without ceasing she worships and honors and sacrifices to it, from its glory and its beauty, that she may delight in their wine and in their drunkenness, which the demons have mixed, that she may sacrifice to them and do their will.
verses.13: And she does not know her Creator, the Lord her God, at all times, who raises her and builds her up from her youth until the days of her maturity, and again until the days of her old age, and until the day of death.
verses.14: And again she will be judged at the resurrection, and her time will be forever, for she did not turn to my law and did not walk in my commandments.
verses.15: Her gods will rise up against her, for if they were true gods, they would contend with her in Gehenna and deliver her when I was angry with her in my wrath, and I destroyed all her allies who conspired with her.
verses.16: And I gave her over to destruction in everything, because she did evil and ruin against my house and my holy ones.
verses.17: And she brought my name, which was named upon her, while they call her 'my people of the Lord' and 'the house of the Lord of Israel,' and the dwelling of his name, the exalted Jerusalem, the holy of holies, the city of the great King.
verses.18: And she boasts in me as though she were my people, and I am her Lord; but she does not fear me and does not do my will as her Lord, but she provokes me like an enemy.
verses.19: And she is jealous for foreign gods, which did not raise her and did not bring her up and did not sustain her, but their poison became a snare for deception, to remove her far from me.
verses.20: And she sacrifices to them and eats their sacrifices and pours out libations to them and drinks the wine of their drink offerings, and she burns incense to them and kindles the fragrance of their incense, and she commands them and is commanded by them.
verses.21: And again she sacrifices sons and daughters, and she is defiled by the work of her hands and by the uncleanness of her lips, for she sacrifices to them because of her love for them.
verses.22: But on the day of judgment, for her and for her gods whom she loved and embraced, she will go down with them into Sheol, the lowest depth, to the fire that does not sleep, which is not quenched.
verses.23: Woe to you, O daughter of Jerusalem, for destruction, because you have forsaken me who created you, and have worshiped foreign gods.
verses.24: And I also, according to your deeds, will requite you, and I will judge you according to your ways, for you have provoked me and rejected my covenant and have not made your deeds upright.
verses.25: And I also would have healed you, and I would not have delayed your salvation, if you had listened to my word and had been instructed by my counsel which I established with you, that you should keep my commandments; and I also would have been with you and would have saved you from all who afflict you, if you would keep my commandments which I commanded you, and my law.
verses.26: And all this you did not keep, and I also rejected you; and when judgment comes, I will judge you. Was it not I who created you? And you did not keep my word and my commandments, though I blessed you that you might be mine.
verses.27: But you have become estranged from me, as Sodom and Gomorrah became estranged.
verses.28: And I also destroyed them in my wrath, for from their root you are of Sodom and Gomorrah, whom I uprooted, and I blotted out their memory from the earth, that they might not live in their wickedness, for they provoked me who created them, by the lying of a man with a woman, and they committed adultery without law, with males and with beasts, as with women.
verses.29: And there was no fear of God before their eyes, from their least to their greatest. And there was none who reproved another, that he should dwell with him, doing good; they helped one another in every evil deed, and all of them were defiled with sin and wickedness, for their deeds were evil.
verses.30: And every evil deed and pride and arrogance and wickedness was established in their hearts.
verses.31: And because of this the Lord rejected them, and he overthrew their cities, and there were those who burned them with fire to their foundations, and none of them remained who survived, and they were destroyed forever.
verses.32: And it will remain until the day of judgment, forever; and the day of judgment is great, for they were bound in sins, and he will not have mercy on them and will not spare them, for they provoked me with their evil deeds.
verses.33: And I also rejected them; and so also you, O daughter of Jerusalem, will be destroyed and bound on the day of judgment, for you will not find one who will intercede for you when I seize you in my wrath, for all your deeds are wickedness and arrogance and evil and fornication and false prophecy, and every way of error and deceit which I do not approve.
verses.34: And I gave you to glory, but you gave yourself to ruin. I called you mine, but you gave yourself to another.
verses.35: And I consecrated you for holiness, but you became the devil's; and I will judge you according to your evil deeds.
verses.36: And I will bring evil upon you because of all this, because you did not hear my word and did not keep my commandments which I commanded you from the day I loved you, for I am the Lord who created you; and I will be angry with all the sinners who are like you, and I will requite them according to their evil on the day of judgment.
verses.37: And as for you, I will judge you with them, for you did not keep my word and you rejected my judgment.
verses.38: O Sodom and Gomorrah, who have no fear of God in your heart!
verses.39: So also you, O city of Jerusalem, you will be judged together with them in the fire of Gehenna, and all who do deeds like yours, for together they will go down to the place prepared, Gehenna, where there is no rest, forever and ever.
verses.40: And you also, and those who did not keep my word and my commandments, they will go down together into Sheol on the day of judgment, because they did not keep my word and my commandments.
verses.41: But those who kept my word and my commandments, whom sinners oppressed and the righteous devoured, and whom the evil ones afflicted, they will be rewarded with mercy and goodness, as the Lord commanded; the righteous and the good will rejoice and be glad.
verses.42: But the sinners and the transgressors will weep and mourn because of all their error, in which they strayed from my commandments.
verses.43: And he who keeps my word and walks in my commandments, he it is who will eat of blessing and will be honored before me.
verses.44: And everyone who keeps my word and does my commandments will eat the blessing of the earth, and to the place of the kings, the good and the chosen, he will enter and dwell.
